properties.headline: Flood Watch issued October 23 at 9:58PM MDT until October 25 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...A portion of south central New Mexico, including Otero
County and portion of far west Texas including El Paso and Hudspeth
Counties.

* WHEN...From Saturday evening through late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Low-water
crossings may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Several rounds of thunderstorms are expected to move through the
region between this evening and late Saturday night. Widespread
rainfall amounts of up to 1" are likely with localized areas
receiving 2-3" resulting in flash flooding.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 23 at 11:43PM EDT until October 24 at 12:15AM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
SMWKEY

The National Weather Service in Key West has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Straits of Florida from Craig Key to Halfmoon Shoal 20 to 60 nm
out...

* Until 1215 AM EDT.

* At 1143 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 27 nm southwest
of Marathon Humps, moving southwest at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...National Weather Service Meteorologist.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Prepare for wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, steep and fast-building
seas, frequent lightning, and blinding downpours. Stay low or go
below, and make sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

properties.areaDesc: Coconino, AZ; Navajo, AZ
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 23 at 8:04PM MST until October 25 at 12:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall on Wednesday and
Thursday continues.

* WHERE...The Little Colorado River from Winslow to Leupp.

* WHEN...Until midnight MST Saturday Night /100 AM MDT Sunday/.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Little Colorado River is imminent or
occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 750 PM MST /850 PM MDT/, Elevated flow continues near Winslow
to Leupp. Elevated flow is forecast to continue through at least
Saturday evening.
- For Little Colorado at Winslow:
At 7:00pm MST /8:00pm MDT/ the stage was 18.06 feet.
Flood Stage is 19.0 feet.
Forecast: A crest near 18 feet is expected at 8:00pm MST /9:00pm
MDT/ Friday.
Impacts:
At 17.0 feet: Downstream, the approaches to the bridge over the
river on Navajo Route 71 near Bird Springs will flood, and Leupp
will be within 3 feet of flooding problems. The river will crest
at Navajo Route 71 approximately 18 hours after the river crests
at Winslow. Minor lowland overflow on right bank at Winslow.
At 18.0 feet: Flow above this level for approximately 6 hours or
more may cause erosion to the levee and eventual leakage or
failure.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Leupp, Birdsprings, Bushman Acres, Homolovi Ruins State Park.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
properties.instruction:
Stay away or be swept away! The banks of rivers are unstable and
unsafe during any flooding event.

Low water crossings will become dangerous. Do not attempt to cross
flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.areaDesc: Mineral, CO; Rio Grande, CO; Saguache, CO
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 23 at 8:59PM MDT until October 23 at 11:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues along the
Rio Grande River and waterways downstream.

* WHERE...Southwestern Saguache, Central Mineral and Western Rio
Grande Counties...

* WHEN...Until 1100 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding will continue along the Rio Grande, especially
from South Fork to Del Norte.  Several roads remain closed due to
flooding...including highway 160 and CO 112 near Del Norte.
Bridges and roads over or near the waterways may be flooded or
compromised by earlier flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 848 PM MDT, Water levels along the Rio Grande will remain
high, especially in the stretch from above South Fork through Del
Norte until the flow recede Saturday morning.
- The South Fork Rio Grande and other area streams are past their
crests and are continuing to fall. The South Fork Rio Grande is
expected to fall back below Flood Stage late tonight.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
The Rio Grande River including the South Fork area and along
highway 160 to Wolf Creek Pass.
- Highway 160, between Wolf Creek Pass and South Fork, continues to
be closed. Continue to heed all road closures.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 23 at 8:43PM MDT until October 23 at 10:45PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding along the Conejos River caused by excessive
rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Western Conejos County in south central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 1045 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding along the Conejos River is expected to continue,
and water flows will remain high in area creeks, streams and
tributaries feeding into the Conejos River. Several roads remain
closed due to flooding. Flooded waterways will continue to run high
into the overnight hours.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 835 PM MDT, Emergency management reported flooding in the
warned area with evacuations remaining in place.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Cumbres Pass, Platoro, Mogote.
- Highway 17 between Antonito and Cumbres Pass remains closed.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.areaDesc: Inland Sussex; Delaware Beaches; Ocean; Coastal Ocean
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 23 at 10:39PM EDT until October 24 at 7:00AM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level in
low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...In Delaware, Inland Sussex and Delaware Beaches. In
New Jersey, Ocean and Coastal Ocean.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water remains trapped in the back bays
where we expect minor flooding to continue. In fact it's
possible minor flooding will continue to be an issue through
Saturday for these back bay areas.
properties.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that minor tidal flooding is
expected. Minor tidal flooding often results in some road
closures. Usually, the most vulnerable roadways will flood.

Do not leave your vehicle at a location that is prone to tidal
flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flood waters. The
water may be deeper than you think it is. You will be putting
yourself in danger and your vehicle may be damaged, leading to
costly repairs.

Visit the National Water Prediction Service at
https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/phi for additional water level and
flood impact information for your local tide gauge.

properties.areaDesc: Monroe Upper Keys
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued October 23 at 10:32PM EDT until October 25 at 5:00AM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Major saltwater flooding.

* WHERE...Upper Keys.

* WHEN...During times of high tide through Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

NWSheadline: COASTAL FLOOD WARNING IN EFFECT

properties.areaDesc: Monroe Middle Keys; Monroe Lower Keys
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 23 at 10:32PM EDT until October 25 at 5:00AM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor to moderate saltwater flooding.

* WHERE...Lower and Middle Keys.

* WHEN...During times of high tide through Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...Saltwater flooding of low elevation streets and lots
is expected. Some storm drains will overflow, and some
seawalls and docks will be overtopped. Boaters can expect less
clearance under fixed bridges. Motorists should remember that
persistent puddles around the times of high tide are almost
certain to contain a mix of saltwater.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
